documents.text: ### `allowErrorHandlerOverride` * **Default:** `false` When set to `false`, it prevents `setErrorHandler` from being called multiple times within the same scope, ensuring that the previous error handler is not unintentionally overridden. Set this option to `true` to allow an error handler to be overridden within the same scope.

| FST_ERR_HANDLER_TIMEOUT | Request timed out. | Increase the `handlerTimeout` option or optimize the handler. | - | | FST_ERR_ROUTE_HANDLER_TIMEOUT_OPTION_NOT_INT | `handlerTimeout` option must be a positive integer. | Use a positive integer for the `handlerTimeout` option. | - Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
